RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the December 10, 2004/Agrahayana 19, 1926 (Saka)

(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests; Food Processing Industries;
Health and Family Welfare; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
Illegal felling of sandalwood trees in
Kerala
*141. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that illegal felling
of sandalwood trees in Marayoor highrange
in Kerala has been rampant, leading to illicit
sandalwood oil distillation in Palakkad
district in Kerala;
(b) whether the forest officials of
Pallakkad district recently raided a few
distillation units using illegal stocks of
sandalwood; and
(c) whether any investigation is being
conducted on reported theft of sandalwood
from Marayoor highrange for clandestine
use by distillation units in Palakkad?
Pollution by thermal power plants
†*142. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) the total quantum of flyash produced
in each thermal power plant through the
waste products released from these plants
annually in the country;
(b) whether any measures have been taken
by Government for checking pollutants
releasing from the thermal power plants;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the total amount being spent
annually  by Government for the same?
Failure of PDS
*143. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR:
SHRI N. K. PREMA-
CHANDRAN:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Public
Distribution System has failed to meet the
expectation of the masses;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government have received
a large number of complaints regarding
identification of beneficiaries, ration card
owners, etc.;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

(d) if so, the reasons therefor;
(e) whether Government would
consider to restore the universal rationing
system by replacing the existing targeted
Public Distribution System; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Physiotherapy Council
*144. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
form a Physiotherapy Council;
(b) if so, the details including the courses
incorporated under the purview of the
proposed Physiotherapy Council;
(c) whether the class I Physiotherapy
course recognised by the Ministry of Health
and Family Welfare OM No. 2867/61/MI/
MPT dated 30th December, 1964 and
record office of Army Medical Corps
instruction No. 91 dated 6th September,
1967 is also incorporated under the purview
of the proposed Physiotherapy Council;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof, and if not,
whether Army Medical Corps will be
consulted before finalising the form of the
Physiotherapy Council?
Cost of production of medicines
*145. SHRI M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS AND
FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
make it compulsory for pharmaceutical
companies to print the cost of production
of medicines on each and every medicine
pack;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether Government have also
discussed this issue with Finance Ministers
and Health Ministers of States recently;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) the steps taken by Government to
ensure availability of medicines at
reasonable prices to the general public?
Extra prices on  medicines
†*146. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS
AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that many
medicines manufacturing companies have
earned extra dividend in recent years by
charging extra price than the prescribed
price of many medicines;
(b) if so, the names of these companies;
(c) the names of medicines which have
been charged extra;
(d) whether Government have taken
action for recovering extra price charged by
these companies; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Functioning of Drugs Control
Organizations
*147. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA : Will the Minister of
HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that sub-standard
medicines in the country are being sold and
the Drug Controller has failed to curb their
sale;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

45
(c) whether Dr. Mashelkar Committee
Report has pointed out the inadequacy in
the Drugs Control Organizations (DCOs)
at the Central and State level and has
recommended the strengthening of DCOs;
and
(d) if so, what steps Government have
taken in this regard?

Cattle breeding farms
840. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of Central cattle
breeding farms which are now functional
in the country and their location, station-
wise;
(b) the present status of their
functioning;
(c) whether there is any proposal to
close down some of them including the one
at Chiplima in Orissa; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor?
Sugarcane production
†841. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER SINGH
MAJITHA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
production of sugarcane has been declining
in the country for last few years;
(b) if so, the production of sugarcane in
2004-05 in comparison to the production
during the year 2000-01;
(c) whether it is also a fact that per
hectare production of sugarcane has
decreased during above years;
(d) if so, year-wise production rate of
sugarcane during above two years; and
(e) the reasons for low level of total
production of sugarcane?
Study report on suicide by farmers
†842. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER SINGH
MAJITHA:
 Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn towards the study report
published by Dr. V. Ratna and Dr. S. Glao
of "Centre for Economic and Social Study"
under the title "Farmers' Suicides: Looking
Beyond the Debt Trap";
(b) if so, whether this report reveals the
detailed information about the causes forcing
farmers to commit suicide; and

(c) if so, the details thereof and the
reaction of Government thereto?
Assessment on yield of Bt. cotton
843. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
undertaken any assessment on the yield of
Bt. Cotton in India, as there has been a lot
of controversy over the reports of the
independent surveys on the performance
of the Bt. Cotton; and
(b) if so, the details of assessment made
by Government in the matter?
Spraying of coca cola on crops as
pesticides
†844. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that farmers in
certain districts in Andhra Pradesh are
spraying coca-cola cold drink as a pesticide
for the protection of their crops;
(b) if so, the facts in this regard; and
(c) whether it is also a fact that the crops
are being protected by the above mentioned
spraying method?
Sreamlining NAIS
845. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of provisions of the Crop
Insurance Scheme in India and various
situations and conditions under which
farmers could become beneficiaries of this
scheme;
(b) whether farmers in various States
are opposing this scheme in view of its
failure to protect their interests;
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
remedial measures taken, so far, and
measures proposed to be implemented to
streamline the scheme;
(d) whether Government are seriously
contemplating to amend the Act of Crop
Insurance Policy in the best interest of the
farmers;
(e) if so, by when; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
Supply of spurious Bt. cotton seeds
846. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
a Multinational Private Company Mahyco
had been supplying inferior quality of Bt.
cotton seeds in Andhra Pradesh leading to
total crop loss;
(b) if so, the details thereof with regards
to Andhra Pradesh and all other States
where such inferior quality of B.T. cotton
seeds are supplied by Mahyco and other
Multinational companies;
(c) the details of action taken so far,
against these companies supplying Bt.
cotton seeds in India; and
(d) the details of action taken so far, for
compensating such loss of the farmers of
Andhra Pradesh and other States?

(c) the number of milch cattle for which
